title: The strict upper cohomology bound for the coimage
statement: Fix a prime ell, an affine scheme X, a bound d, and a commutative condensed ring Lambda isomorphic to Z_ell, O_E, Q_ell or E, with E/Q_ell finite [sk-def-localizing-closure, def-pc-scheme]. Use ordinary internal modules on the small pro-etale site and ordinary uncompleted derived sections [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-sfb-condensed-module-sections]. Suppose every affine etale V -> X has torsion etale cohomological dimension at most d [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. Let M,N lie in the weak Serre coproduct hull of finite constant scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible], with H^r RΓ(M[0]) = H^r RΓ(N[0]) = 0 for r>d+2, and f:M -> N any actual module map. Then H^q RΓ(coim(f)[0]) = 0 for every integer q>d+2. No vanishing in degree d+2 is asserted.

source.place: Paragraph (2), first paragraph, affine coefficient-transfer obligation; the arbitrary-map relation-resolution step isolated in lem-sfb-weak-serre-supported-derived-generation. Agent formulation; exact full-generality reference WANTED.

proof.text: For q>d+2 choose the natural number e=q-2, so e+2=q and d<=e. The torsion etale dimension hypothesis is monotone in its natural-number bound: a degree above e is above d. The input source and target vanishings above d+2 imply the corresponding vanishings above e+2.
Apply lem-sfb-torsion-cd-critical-coimage-surjectivity with the larger bound e. It gives an epimorphism H^(e+2) RGamma(M[0]) -> H^(e+2) RGamma(coim(f)[0]) along the actual coimage quotient.
Since e+2=q>d+2, the source of that epimorphism is zero by hMb. An epimorphism from a zero object has zero target (Mathlib IsZero.of_epi). Rewrite e+2=q to get the desired coimage vanishing.

proof_origin.place: Specialization of torsionCd_critical_coimage_surjectivity at the larger bound e=(q-2).toNat, followed by Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero.of_epi; written by C1, 2026-10-26.

theorem torsionCd_bounded_serre_coimage
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ :
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (d : ℕ)
    (hcd : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsAffine V] [Etale v],
      V.HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE d)
    (M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hM : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) M)
    (hN : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) N)
    (hMb : ∀ q : ℤ, (d : ℤ) + 2 < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))))
    (hNb : ∀ q : ℤ, (d : ℤ) + 2 < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))))
    (q : ℤ) (hq : (d : ℤ) + 2 < q) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (Abelian.coimage f))))
